behavioral_guards: Capabilities are fetched before packs are conditionally requested.
metadata_supported=false skips active-pack loading and hides all visible draft authoring UI.
ZIP input and import button remain disabled until capabilities load and whenever authoring is explicitly unsupported.
Expression slots and neutral binding resolution continue on the unsupported path.
An explicit metadata_supported=true control retains active-pack loading and enabled ZIP controls.
A missing metadata_supported flag remains authoring-capable after capability loading; the two existing import/draft tests cover that legacy response shape.
